metadata.description: Joseph Alfonso's bank of AI skills, personas and agents.

plugins.name: design-guide
plugins.description: Start here. Describe what you need and get a diagnosis, then the right resource run for you: every prompt, persona, template and design-review framework in the bank, picked by stage.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write and edit in Joseph's voice: staged drafting, a banned-phrase list, and a learning loop from his edits.

plugins.name: review-personas
plugins.description: 20 critique and rehearsal personas (design, stakeholder, interview, reality checks) as a review-as skill plus 12 reviewer subagents.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Design review frameworks: a fast Design Review Card, the AI Design Evaluation Rubric, and the evidence-based AI Readiness Review (AIRR-1.0).

plugins.name: prompt-library
plugins.description: 81 career prompts (job search, interviews, offers, portfolio, user research, design work, AI product design, leadership, mentoring, writing, career growth, building with AI) with a skill that fills them in and runs them.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Personal setup, edit the Config sections before use. Job search automations: live LinkedIn digest, Gmail-to-tracker updates, interview prep briefs, resume and cover letter tailoring.

plugins.name: daily-ops
plugins.description: Personal setup, edit before use. Daily and weekly routines: morning calendar and email briefing, personal knowledge base cleanup.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that back three rules: never kill processes by pattern or in bulk (pkill, killall, xargs kill, kill -1), never delete files or discard uncommitted git work (archive into _archive/ or stash instead), and confirm before any git push to main or master. Checks command text, including inside bash -c and eval; not a sandbox.

plugins.name: bank-guide
plugins.description: Install this one globally. Start a coding project or ask which agent fits a job, and it picks the right plugin kit from the bank and enables it in the repo.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Working roster for any coding project: engineer, designer, spec-writer, debugger, code-reviewer, test-writer, marketer. The main session orchestrates; the engineer never reviews its own work.

plugins.name: game-team
plugins.description: Game project agents: art-director, artist, playtester. Expects a DESIGN.md at the repo root and a docs/ASSETS.md log.

plugins.name: web-team
plugins.description: Web project agents: a11y-auditor and tech-writer.

plugins.name: ai-team
plugins.description: AI feature agents: eval-writer, which writes evals under evals/.
